scope: Independent root review of exact r18 Android fixed metadata worker ELF
findings: Start at 0x3040 calls the own clone trampoline once at 0x33ca: Worker 0x3900, null context, flags 0x350900, identical parent/clear-tid address 0x1cd94.
The raw trampoline aligns the private stack, calls only its stored fixed entry and contains only clone/exit syscall sites.
The actual Android worker closure comprises Worker, ReadContext and SameContext; the recursive auditor reports no libc/PLT, TLS, canary/runtime or unresolved transfer.
Source review covers the fixed typed Snapshot lifetime, complete-as-last-request-access, explicit retirement and kernel clear-tid wait. Eight actual core files are byte-identical to frozen R7.
limitations: R7 defaults off and ART/engine lifecycle hooks are not installed.
Known NOFILE0 EMFILE remains; trusted root factory and trusted O_PATH positives are absent.
Sampled caller/worker contexts do not prove arbitrary native credential/root/mount transitions.
The host namespace helper does not replace exact owned app cleanup or full cgroup cleanup.
